Looping in my notes from a quick template scan:

- Exhibit set: Billing + SLA + Security addendum exist. SLA has standard latency SLO language that will need scope aligning with their Exhibit A usage metrics.
- Data residency: we have a standard addendum for region carveouts — will propose us-east-1 as a default but call out multi-region hosting as optional.
- Liability: default cap is 12 months of fees; we can propose a 6- or 12-month alternative depending on deal size — recommend starting with 12 months and have a fallback of $5M if they push for higher.
- Termination for convenience: we typically allow 30 days with cure for smaller customers, 90 for enterprise.

I started a redline focused on the clauses above and added inline comments where we need BluePolaris to confirm operational constraints (e.g., expected ingest TPS, retention schedule). I’ll hand this to Kimberly for review and then produce the customer-facing redline.

Marissa\Senior Counsel, Contracts\Redwood Inference
